$comment: USD per million tokens (`05` §3.9.2). Every Anthropic row was read off platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing on 2026-11-12, and one correction came out of it: Sonnet 5.5's cache read is $0.10, not the $0.20 the plan's table carried — cache hits on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 are 0.05x base input, and 0.05 × $2 is $0.10. A doubled cache-read price would have overstated the cost of the route a family uses most, in the direction that makes the budget guard degrade a group that had not spent its budget. `null` means unknown, and the guard falls back to Opus rates so the error is in the safe direction. OpenAI rows added at `M2-T11`, read off developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing on 2026-11-13. The 30-minute and 12-hour cache-write prices map onto the `cacheWrite5m` and `cacheWrite1h` columns by **slot**, not by equal duration: the columns are the short and long priced slots, and 30m/12h are this provider's. `05` §3.5.4's cost formula predates these columns existing on OpenAI at all and would have charged cache writes at zero.
